info.about: Patapon 3 is a 2011 rhythm video game developed by Pyramid and Japan Studio and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation Portable. It is the final installment in the Patapon series and a sequel to Patapon 2 (2008).
info.trivia: The third game arrived in 2011 and, unlike its predecessors, never received a PS4 remaster.
info.why: A late, small print run and no re-release make it the expensive Patapon.
